trial_court: Court of Sh. Rakesh Kumar Rampuri, Additional Senior Civil Judge, JSCC: Guardian Judge, Karkardooma Courts (East), C.S. No. 1170/18
case_name: Sh. Subhash Kumar vs Sh. Shiv Mohan Saini @ Sonu

parties.respondent_defendant: Sh. Shiv Mohan Saini @ Sonu, defendant

facts_of_case: The plaintiff sought recovery of Rs. 25,000 alongwith pendente-lite and future interest as well as litigation cost from the defendant.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove his case.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff has instituted the present suit for recovery of an amount of Rs. 25,000/- against defendant on 30.11.2018.

legal_principles.principle: A plaintiff's demand for payment must be reasonable and not excessive.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff has served a legal demand notice dated 06.10.2018 to the defendant but despite being served of said legal notice, defendant failed to make the due payment to him.

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the defendant to pay the balance amount of Rs. 25,000 to the plaintiff.

use_for_drafting: preparing a civil suit for recovery of amount
